Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: Misapplied biology facts by (a) treating the animal extracellular matrix/glycocalyx as a “cell wall” and claiming cell walls are common to animals and plants, and (b) excluding mitochondria based on an outlier (mature mammalian RBCs). Standard biology teaches animals lack cell walls and both plant and animal cells (typically) have cell membranes, nuclei, and mitochondria, so the correct option is B, not C.
